title: ARV spelled out as 'alien reproduction vehicle' in the briefing, seen as counterintelligence marker

tellings.quote: you know, to the best of my recollection, it was expanded as alien reproduction vehicle.

plain: In a 2018 Pentagon briefing on a secret programme he calls Immaculate Constellation, the letters ARV were spelled out as "alien reproduction vehicle", according to Matthew Brown, a former Pentagon official who has become a whistleblower. Brown says this is "to the best of my recollection", names the former Pentagon official Luis Elizondo in connection with it, and reads the wording as a sign of counterintelligence at work, a phrase planted on purpose rather than a plain description.
